_note: Measured once from G03.mp4 (96 frames at 24 fps, 4.0 s loop): blue arm tip row per frame. topStart = first frame the arm is within 6 px of its highest point, topEnd = last such frame, downBy = first frame back at the resting row. The hero counter is driven from the video clock with these numbers; scripts/check-demo-sync.mjs asserts it.
